name: Rankoshi (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Rankoshi town emblem in yellow, black and white: a yellow disc with four spokes enclosing a white stylised flower on black.
history: Municipal flag of Rankoshi, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 December 1954.

features.role: Rankoshi town emblem — a yellow disc with four spokes enclosing a white stylised flower on black
